title: ComponentShareAdoptionRequest
description: POST /service/v1/component-directory/bindings/{bindingId}/share-adoptions (DD-164(4)⑧): before its first schema 2 convergence a component registers an existing native share of a Kailo-mapped object as a Kailo share. Creates the component.shared_object Resource with these grants only when none exists; otherwise answers the existing Resource unchanged.

grants.description: Mapped from the native permission: viewer -> READ, editor/admin -> WRITE; the owner is implicit.
